The '''''White Wing''''' was a customized [[YZ-900 freighter|YZ-900]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. The ship sacrificed weaponry and added extensive droid automation; this lowered the amount of crewmen necessary to run the ship, so much that a single individual could pilot the ship.<ref name="G2" />

The automation involved linking the ship's sensors directly to a group of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromechs]]. To simplify the weaponry, the fore and aft concussion missile tubes were removed completely, and the wing-mounted lasers were fixed so they could only fire forward, although the turret-mounted heavy lasers in the centre of the hull were retained. However, even with this reduced armament, and droid-assisted [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computers]], a single pilot could not control all the weaponry at once, and it was more effectively handled with two additional gunners on board.<ref name="G2" />

During period leading to the fall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the ''White Wing'' made frequent trips to and from [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Space]]. Rumour claimed that the ship was being used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to deploy [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|special forces]] units for attacks against Hutt targets and Imperial outposts, although the truth was not really known.<ref name="G2" />

Whoever the ship's original owners were, they abandoned the ship shortly after the termination of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The ship spent some time simply sitting in a docking bay, and was eventually sold to recover the credits owed for its time there.<ref name="G2" />
